findingsAndLimits.manualProcedure: Relative radius=1+percent/100; Q/Q0=(1+percent/100)⁴. Rigid Poiseuille model, unchanged pressure difference/length/viscosity. Convert percent, then square twice.

Q/Q₀ = (1 + Δr/100)⁴
